title: 1 · Pinyin: initials and finals
blurb: Read any pinyin syllable aloud roughly right, and know the letters that do not sound the way English spells them.

title: 2 · Four tones and the neutral tone
blurb: Hear and say the four tones and the neutral tone, and tell apart words that differ only in tone.

title: 3 · Tone changes: 不, 一, third tone
blurb: Say 不 and 一 with the right tone, and say two third tones in a row the way Chinese speakers do.

title: 4 · How characters work: strokes and radicals
blurb: Recognize about 25 basic characters and see how pictures, compounds and radicals build the rest.

title: 5 · Hello, thank you, sorry: Chinese courtesy
blurb: Say hello, thank you, sorry and goodbye, give your name, and know when to use the polite 您.

title: 6 · Pronouns and 们
blurb: Say I, you, he, she, we and they, make them plural with 们, and say my friend or their teacher.

title: 7 · 是: A is B
blurb: Say who you are and where you are from with 是, and say what you are not with 不是.

title: 8 · Adjectives with 很 (no 是)
blurb: Describe people and things with 很, 不 and 太…了, without the 是 that English makes you want.

title: 9 · Questions with 吗 and 呢
blurb: Ask yes/no questions with 吗, answer them the Chinese way, and ask back with 你呢.

title: 10 · Question words: 什么, 谁, 哪儿, 几
blurb: Ask what, who, where, which country and how many, keeping the Chinese word order.

title: 11 · Negation: 不 and 没 (not, didn't)
blurb: Say what you don't do, what you don't have, and what didn't happen, with the right word for "not".

title: 12 · 的: possession and describing
blurb: Say whose something is and what it is like, with the owner or the describer before the noun.

title: 13 · 有: have and there is
blurb: Say what you have, ask a shop if it has something, and say what there is in a place.

title: 14 · Numbers and money
blurb: Count past a hundred, say prices in yuan, ask how much something costs, and choose between 二 and 两.

title: 15 · Measure words: 个, 本, 杯
blurb: Count things and point at them the Chinese way: number or this / that + measure word + noun.

title: 16 · Ordering food and drinks
blurb: Call the server, order dishes and drinks with the right measure words, ask for no spice, and pay.

title: 17 · Family and age
blurb: Name your family members, say how many people are in your family, and ask someone's age the right way.

title: 18 · Time and dates
blurb: Tell the time, name the days of the week and dates, and put time words where Chinese wants them.

title: 19 · 在: at, in, and location words
blurb: Say where things and people are, use on, in, next to and across from, and say where you do something.

title: 20 · Word order: who · when · where · verb
blurb: Build longer sentences in the Chinese line-up: who, when, where, how, and the verb last.

title: 21 · 想, 要, 会, 能: want and can
blurb: Say what you want, what you'd like, what you know how to do, and ask if you may.

title: 22 · 了: done, and changed (not a past tense)
blurb: Use 了 to say an action is done or something has changed, and know when to leave it out.

title: 23 · 在 and 正在: doing it right now
blurb: Say what someone is doing right now, and ask what they are doing.

title: 24 · Two verbs in a row: 去 + verb
blurb: Say where you're going and what you'll do there, and how you get there, with no word for "to".

title: 25 · Verb-not-verb questions: 去不去
blurb: Ask yes/no questions the second Chinese way, verb + 不 + verb, and answer them.

title: 26 · 也, 都, 还: also, all, still
blurb: Say "too", "all", "both", "still" and "not yet" with the words in the right place.

title: 27 · 吧 and 别: let's, and don't
blurb: Suggest things with 吧, tell people not to with 别, and ask politely with 请 and 麻烦你.

title: 28 · 和 and 还是: and, or
blurb: Join people and things with 和, and ask and answer "this or that?" with 还是 and 或者.
